note: Interest the venues pay on capital held in positions ('carry'), used for total return = arbitrage + carry (docs/TAKER_REVIEW.md, A1). Neither venue publishes these in an API: update this file by hand when a venue changes its rate. Each entry applies from its 'from' date until the next entry. Polymarket holding rewards apply only to markets with holdingRewardsEnabled = true in that day's market snapshot.

kalshi_apy_pct.source: Kalshi blog: interest on cash and open positions launched October 2025 at 4.05% APY
Kalshi help center 'APY on Kalshi', verified 2026-11-17 (US users; average monthly balance >= $250). The date it changed from 4.05% is not known; applied from the start of this project's data.

polymarket_holding_rewards_pct.source: Polymarket holding rewards launch: 4% annualized on eligible long-dated markets
Third-party guide citing Polymarket's help center, June 2026; not independently verified. No watched market was eligible as of 2026-11-17.
